label: Network preferences *Requests 10 persistent connections per server, disables request pacing, sets speculative limit 12, and changes DNS/TLS cache limits. Captures prior values before changes; re-sync preserves later manual edits. No load-time improvement has been measured by this mod.*

Native HTTPS link-hover preconnection *Enables Firefox's built-in speculative connections from HTTPS page-link hover. Turbo does not wrap the page-link status handler. Requests can occur without a later navigation.*
Session-store interval *Sets browser.sessionstore.interval to 30000 milliseconds. Fewer scheduled writes can also leave more recent session changes unpersisted after a crash.*
Media memory cache *Sets media.memory_cache_max_size to 65536 KiB (64 MiB). Actual allocation and reuse depend on Firefox and the media workload.*

Suspend tab effects during workspace animations *Temporarily disables tab-strip blur and transitions and hides sidebar videos. Keeps the floating sidebar and native page-strip blur active. Restores effects after 1500 ms even if Zen leaves an animation marker set. Frame-time impact is not measured.*
Request GPU rendering paths *Sets gfx.webrender.all and gfx.canvas.accelerated when present. Effect depends on Firefox and the graphics driver. Disabled by default.*

Request connections on hover *Requests a speculative connection after dwelling on an unloaded tab or bookmark. Unloaded tabs use their container; bookmarks use container 0. Request throttle is half network.http.keep-alive.timeout; no connection reuse is measured.*
Hover dwell (milliseconds) *Delay before requesting a speculative connection. Default 200; 0 requests immediately. Leaving before the delay expires cancels the pending request.*

Request frequent origins at window startup *Queries local history and schedules speculative requests 250 ms apart. Disabled in private windows. Requests can consume network resources without a later navigation.*
Startup origin count *Selects up to this many origins by history frecency. Default 6; maximum 20.*
Startup delay (milliseconds) *Delay after window initialization before querying history. Default 4000. Does not guarantee session restore has finished.*
Count navigation matches *Correlates navigation origins and containers with recent warmup requests. ZenTurbo.stats().hitRate is a navigation-match percentage, not socket reuse or time saved.*
Log activity *Prints request and preference activity to Browser Console under [ZenTurbo].*
